subject: Public mathematical integral posts, especially Facebook
method: Public web search engine 1; exact-name, spelling-variant, mathematical-context, and Facebook-restricted searches. Results were reviewed as returned. No logged-in sessions, private-account probing, direct contact, or messages were used.
interpretation: No returned result established both the requested identity and mathematical integral content. Some responses relaxed the exact terms or domain restriction and returned unrelated pages. A search miss does not establish that the person or posts do not exist. No similarly named person was linked to the requested author.

query_batches.outcome: No verified name-and-mathematics match. Returned pages were unrelated travel, entertainment, retail, business-directory, or other name-token matches.
No verified public Facebook profile or integral post. Returned pages were irrelevant catalog, retail, yoga, or geographic Lyon matches.
No verified exact-name mathematical contributor. Unrelated single-name, sporting, travel, and entertainment hits were rejected.

rejected_result_examples.reason: Travel page with a first-name token; no requested full-name identity or mathematical integral content.

evidence_limits: This bounded follow-up adds 22 public-search queries. Historical search counts reported in earlier work were not rerun and are not included in this new count. Search result references are audit breadcrumbs, not durable profile identifiers. No verified source URLs were found for the requested contributor.
